title: Dental PPO Plans Claims Manual: Allowance on Reprocessed Initial-Wait Lines
content:
Claims Manual excerpt, Dental PPO Plans. The allowance a line reprocessed after a denial for the waiting period counted from the coverage effective date (a reprocessed initial-wait line) is figured on follows the billed procedure, and so decides the patient share on such a line.

**Clause.**
1. A posterior composite filling on a plan with the posterior composite alternate benefit, or a porcelain or ceramic crown (CDT D2740, D2750, D2751, D2752 or D2783) on a molar (teeth 1, 2, 3, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 30, 31 and 32) on a plan with the molar crown alternate benefit, whose billed amount is not below its alternate allowance, is figured on its alternate allowance.
2. Any line whose billed amount is below the allowance that would otherwise apply (the alternate allowance for such a filling or crown, the allowed amount otherwise) is figured on its billed amount.
3. Every remaining line is figured on its allowed amount.

**Plans with each alternate benefit.**
| Plan | Posterior composite alternate benefit | Molar crown alternate benefit |
|---|---|---|
| Preventive 750 | Yes | No |
| Value 1000 | Yes | No |
| Classic 1250 | Yes | Yes |
| Plus 1500 | Yes | Yes |
| Premier 2000 | No | No |
| Elite 2500 | No | No |

### Cases (hypothetical amounts)
| Line | Billed | Allowed | Alternate allowance | Figured on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Posterior composite, Value 1000 | 181.00 | 162.40 | 118.70 | 118.70 (alternate allowance) |
| Posterior composite, Value 1000 | 109.50 | 162.40 | 118.70 | 109.50 (billed below the alternate allowance) |
| Porcelain crown D2750 on tooth 30, Plus 1500 | 1210.00 | 980.30 | 811.60 | 811.60 |
| Porcelain crown D2750 on tooth 8, Plus 1500 | 1210.00 | 980.30 | 811.60 | 980.30 (not a molar) |
| Amalgam filling, any plan | 97.00 | 104.80 | none | 97.00 (billed below the allowed amount) |
| Posterior composite, Premier 2000 | 181.00 | 162.40 | 118.70 | 162.40 |
